name: ResumeClassic

props.name: doc
props.desc: The tailored content for one job, from @/features/jobs/lib/documents. Absent: the fictional DEMO_RESUME.

props.name: page
props.desc: The paper: US Letter (default) or A4 — sizes the sheet on screen and the @page for print.

whenUse: A job application needs its resume laid out as one professional single-column page — real text in reading order, standard headings, so both a person and an applicant-tracking system read it.
whenNot: A cover letter — use CoverLetterClassic. Anything shown inside the app chrome rather than printed or sent — use the shared/ui kit.

tests.name: ResumeClassic — every fact reaches the page as real text, in reading order
